name: tgl-motion-graphics
description: Motion reels rendered from deterministic HTML/SVG frames with true motion blur and procedural soundtracks: Grow Label (root), Bryant Dental (bryant-dental/), Everyone's Energy (everyones-energy/) and My Origin Report (my-origin-report/).

scripts.audio: npm run cues && python3 scripts/audio.py out/cues.json out/soundtrack.wav
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run frames && npm run encode
scripts.bryant:audio: node bryant-dental/scripts/cues.mjs > bryant-dental/out/cues.json && python3 bryant-dental/scripts/audio.py bryant-dental/out/cues.json bryant-dental/out/soundtrack.wav
scripts.bryant:encode: GRAIN=3 python3 scripts/encode.py bryant-dental/out/frames bryant-dental/out/soundtrack.wav bryant-dental/out/bryant-dental-reel.mp4
scripts.bryant:build: npm run bryant:audio && npm run bryant:frames && npm run bryant:encode
scripts.energy:audio: node everyones-energy/scripts/cues.mjs > everyones-energy/out/cues.json && python3 everyones-energy/scripts/audio.py everyones-energy/out/cues.json everyones-energy/out/soundtrack.wav
scripts.energy:build: npm run energy:audio && npm run energy:frames && npm run energy:encode
scripts.origin:audio: node my-origin-report/scripts/cues.mjs > my-origin-report/out/cues.json && python3 my-origin-report/scripts/audio.py my-origin-report/out/cues.json my-origin-report/out/soundtrack.wav
scripts.origin:build: npm run origin:audio && npm run origin:frames && npm run origin:encode
